changelog: **Time to hire starts at funnel entry (#1505):** journeys in the funnel, forecast and deal-value routes and the mentor's average days to hired start at `funnelStartedAt()` (`src/lib/placement.ts`, `funnelEnteredAt ?? startDate`) instead of the pairing's `startDate`, so a coaching pair that later entered the funnel no longer carries its coaching months. Rows without a stamp read exactly as before. Unit-tested in `scripts/test/placement-kind.test.mjs`.

en: Time to hire now counts from the day someone entered the hiring pipeline, not from the day the mentoring began.
tr: İşe alım süresi artık mentorluğun başladığı günden değil, kişinin işe alım hattına girdiği günden sayılıyor.
de: Die Zeit bis zur Einstellung zählt jetzt ab dem Eintritt in die Einstellungspipeline, nicht ab Beginn des Mentorings.
